goal: Retrain a TPI graph world model from real sampled-subcircuit Atalanta labels with candidate ranking, action-type/SA0-SA1 heads, and long-horizon marginal coverage prediction; select only on b15 and uniformly beat DeepTPI on all five exact-legal ITC99 circuits.

metric.name: uniform_exact_deeptpi_units_remaining
metric.definition: number of non-winning circuits plus summed TC deficit in percentage points; add 100 if uniform/exact audit fails

pipeline.reason: b15-only winner improved macro TC but regressed exact-legal b22 and b17; worse strict metric than Round13
Conservative typed-only residual selected only on b15 improved b15/b20 but regressed long-horizon b22/b17; worse strict metric than Round13
Real 32-step typed-head training plus b15-selected trust decay recovered b22 partially but early off-policy reordering still regressed b22/b17; worse strict metric than Round13
On-policy real 32-step typed-head training selected only on b15 improves the strict metric over Round13; exact/uniform audit passes, but b22 and b17 remain below DeepTPI by 0.707pp and 0.469pp
